tools.name: resolve_family_office
tools.description: Resolve an identifier (LEI, legal name, alias or register id) to the family-office records that carry it, with the node that serves each.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: The Family Office Record for one identifier: every field with value, source_url, read_by and state; optionally a named version.

tools.name: list_events_since
tools.description: Dated, URL'd events on one record (registrations, renewals, orders, acquisitions), oldest first, optionally since a date, paged by cursor.

tools.name: list_aliases
tools.description: Every name the record carries for one identifier — legal name, register names, other names — each with its source.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: The graph's nodes — one per jurisdiction — with record counts read from each node's index, the node door and its as-of.
